description: This file defines the main route module for a Node.js Express backend API. It sets up various endpoint routes for health checks, fetching show categories, featured items, banners, episodes, show details by ID, and serving a demo video URL. It also includes Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Health endpoint that checks service health via healthController.check

methods.name: router.get('/api/trending')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve trending shows via showsController.trending

methods.name: router.get('/api/continue_watching')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve 'continue watching' list via showsController.continueWatching

methods.name: router.get('/api/action')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve action shows via showsController.action

methods.name: router.get('/api/family')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve family shows via showsController.family

methods.name: router.get('/api/comedy')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve comedy shows via showsController.comedy

methods.name: router.get('/api/horror')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve horror shows via showsController.horror

methods.name: router.get('/api/drama')
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve drama shows via showsController.drama

methods.name: router.get('/api/play')
methods.description: Returns the absolute URL to the demo video, dynamically computed from request context

methods.name: router.use('/api/featured')
methods.description: Mounts the featured route, handling GET requests to /api/featured

methods.name: router.use('/api/banner')
methods.description: Mounts the banner route, returning random banner image URLs

methods.name: router.use('/api/episodes')
methods.description: Mounts the episodes route, listing available episodes based on server directory scan

methods.name: router.get('/api/info/:id?')
methods.description: Returns detailed show info by ID or via query parameter, using infoController.get

methods.name: router.get('/api/:category')
methods.description: Generic endpoint to retrieve shows by category name
